title: Researcher will examine galactic evolution with new ‘Roman’ space telescope
summary_en: A University of Kansas researcher will co-direct one of the major debut experiments of the latest space telescope, called GRACE: the Grism Reionization and Cosmic Evolution Survey.
title_cn: Researcher will examine galactic evolution with new ‘Roman’ space telescope

title: 21 University of Kansas students selected for the 2026 Millennium Fellowship class
summary_en: Selected from a record-breaking 76,000 applicants from more than 6,000 campuses worldwide, 21 University of Kansas students were recently chosen for the 2026 Millennium Fellowship, a leadership development program that partners with the United Nations Academic Impact and is overseen by the Millennium Campus Network.
title_cn: 21 University of Kansas students selected for the 2026 Millennium Fellowship class

title: 2026 Lelon Capps Lecture will explore effective mathematics instruction and teacher preparation
summary_en: The KU School of Education & Human Sciences will welcome Angela Barlow, dean of the College of Education and Professional Studies and professor of mathematics education at the University of South Alabama, as the 2026 Lelon Capps featured lecturer. She will give a talk at 4:30 p.m. Sept. 28.
title_cn: 2026 Lelon Capps Lecture will explore effective mathematics instruction and teacher preparation
